research.facts:
Ricky Joy Sour Crush Candy Bottle Recall
**Sources:**
- CPSC.gov: "Ricky Joy Recalls More Than 2.3 Million Sour Crush Candy Bottles Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Choking Hazard" (cpsc.gov/Recalls/2026)
- PIRG: "2.3 million Ricky Joy rolling liquid candy bottles recalled"
- kens5.com, wfaa.com, cbs8.com, king5.com: "More than 2 million sour candy bottles recalled over choking hazard"
- consumeraffairs.com: "Consumer product safety recall roundup for September 11, 2026"
- Daily Voice: "Ricky Joy Recalls 2.3M Rolling Liquid Candy Bottles"
**Key Facts (HIGH — from CPSC.gov):**
- Recall: 2.3 million+ Sour Crush Rolling Liquid Candy bottles
- Hazard: rollerball top can detach from bottle — choking hazard (risk of serious injury or death)
- Product: 1.85 fl oz bottles of sour liquid candy, in blue raspberry, strawberry, green apple, watermelon
- Sold: individually and in 3- or 12-packs
- Sold at: H-E-B, Forman Mills, Walmart.com, CandyFunHouse.com, RickyJoy.com, other retailers
- Sale period: January 2023 through May 2026
- Price: ~$3 single / $13–$32 pack
- Injuries: None reported
- Remedy: stop use immediately, take from children, contact Ricky Joy for full refund
- Consumer contact: 404-975-0352 (8 AM–5 PM ET Mon–Fri); rickyjoy.com/pages/recall

Finger Light Toys Recall (Multiple Companies)
**Sources:**
- CPSC.gov: "Cade California Electronic Recalls Finger Light Toys Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys"
- CPSC.gov: "Oitnlaughter Projecting Finger Light Toys Recalled" (sold by Delightmi on Amazon)
- CPSC.gov: "Projecting LED Finger Light Toys Recalled" (sold by POPOOO on Amazon)
- CPSC.gov: "Syera Projecting Finger Light Toys Recalled" (sold on TEMU by Senyu)
- consumeraffairs.com: "Consumer product safety recall roundup for September 11, 2026"
- KIRO7: "Recall alert: Finger light toys recalled because children can access button cell batteries"
- Fox Business: "Hundreds of thousands of finger light toys sold on Amazon recalled over swallowing risk"
- Medical Daily: "Nearly 180,000 Finger Light Toys Sold on Amazon Are Recalled"
**Key Facts (HIGH — from CPSC.gov):**
- Cade California Electronic recall: ~179,739 projecting finger light toys
- Hazard: three button cell batteries can be easily accessed by children; if swallowed = severe internal chemical burns and death
- Product: 50-piece box containing finger lights in white, blue, red, green; label reads "California Cade Electronic" and "Finger Flashlights"
- Sold at: Amazon.com from March 2015 through July 2026
- Price: $5–$16
- Remedy: discard immediately, email photo of disposed product for full refund
- Additional brands: Oitnlaughter (Delightmi/Amazon), POPOOO (Amazon), Syera (Senyu/TEMU) — same hazard

research.facts:
Back-to-School Screen Time/Sleep Research
**Sources:**
- PMC/NCBI: "The effect of technology use on sleep quality in primary school-aged children" (2026)
- PMC/NCBI: "Prolonged screen time is associated with increased prevalence of sleep disorders in children" (2026)
- AAP: "Screen Time Affecting Sleep" (healthychildren.org/aap.org)
- AAP: "Sleep Duration, Restfulness, and Screens in the Sleep Environment" (Pediatrics journal)
- CHOC Children's: "Updated AAP recommendations for screen time"
**Key Facts (HIGH — from AAP.org/healthychildren.org):**
- AAP: No screens for children under 18 months
- AAP: Ages 2-5: 1 hour per day of high-quality content
- AAP: Ages 6+: prioritize quality and conversation over strict limits
- Sleep recommendation: 6-13yo need 9-11 hours/night; teens 14-17 need 8-10 hours/night
**Key Facts (HIGH — from peer-reviewed research, 2026):**
- Screen use extended sleep latency by 84% on average (equivalent to ~23.1 minutes delayed sleep onset)
- Strong correlation between screen use and poor sleep habits in elementary school children
- Screen use 1 hour before bedtime decreases quality and quantity of sleep
**COS-specific (HIGH):**
- D11: started Aug 12, week 5 as of Sep 14
- D49: started Aug 3, week 6 as of Sep 14
- D20: started Aug 17, week 4 as of Sep 14
